name: Shingyouji Makiyo
source:
Makiyo is a classmate of Kaoruko and Chihaya. She called Ouji-sama (which means prince), and is a popular person. Because of this, her new close friends Kaoruko and Kiyora are envied by other students for a while. Her emotional ups and downs are large, and she ignores even her close friends when she is in bad mood.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru:_Futari_no_Elder]Wikipedia[/url].]
